source_evidence: Brokers and investment advisers offer a variety of services at a variety of prices. It pays to comparison shop.
answer: When comparing investment professionals, look at both the services offered and what you will pay for them. A firm’s relationship summary describes its services, fees, and costs, and uses similar headings to help you compare firms. Ask how and how much the professional is paid. If a fee is quoted as a percentage, ask what that amount means in dollars so you can understand the cost.
